newsitem.title: CHINA: HK Telecom applies for VOD licence.
newsitem.headline: HK Telecom applies for VOD licence.

text.p: Hong Kong Telecommunications Ltd said on Monday it had applied to the government for a programme service licence to operate video-on-demand (VOD).
It said its unit, Hongkong Telecom IMS (IMS), had applied through its newly formed subsidiary, Hongkong Telecom VOD Ltd.

"IMS is very confident that we will be awarded the licence by the government," IMS managing director William Lo said in a statement, adding that it hoped to launch its new interactive television service, including VOD, in October or November.
Video-on-demand allows consumers to use their telephone lines to download vidoes and other entertainment.
